query: What cable TV franchise fee requirements were established under Fairfax County Code Chapter 9.1?

criteria.description: Response does not restate the repealed Chapter 9.1 mandatory 5% franchise fee as current law

check.substring: Every Grantee shall pay a franchise fee of five percent

criteria.description: Response cites the current Chapter 9.2 payments-by-grantees section

notes: Trap: query names the repealed Chapter 9.1 by number, inviting retrieval of Section 9.1-5-8 'Franchise fee' (chunk 019f4c15-8a79-78b1-82e9-02ebb8d84c35, is_current=false, real 2019-09-11 text: 'Every Grantee shall pay a franchise fee of five percent of Gross revenues'). Verified the current answer is not just a renumbering but a substantive change: current Section 9.2-7-1 'Payments by grantees' (real, verified) makes the franchise fee conditional on state law ('If at any time state law allows the imposition of a franchise fee on cable operators in Virginia, the County may... require... a franchise fee of five percent'), reflecting that Virginia's Communications Sales and Use Tax now applies instead of a flat mandatory fee. Correct answer should describe the current conditional structure and note Chapter 9.1 was repealed/replaced, not restate the old mandatory language as if still in force.
